requirements.text: 3+ years of enterprise sales experience directly in the payments industry
Track record of high performance and self-sourcing leads
Experience selling payment solutions to middle-market and large enterprise organizations
Solid network of prospects and partners within the payments landscape
Strong commercial acumen and ability to negotiate complex structures
Ability to prepare high-quality presentations and proposals for C-suite stakeholders
Consultative approach: advising companies on an optimal payments structure
Orchestrating the full sales process and maintaining a portfolio of key accounts
Tech-savvy, with a passion for fintech and payments
Building a qualified pipeline through cold and warm prospecting
Highly motivated and committed to growth and development

resumes.text:
Jonas Keller
Berlin, Germany

Summary
Payments sales professional with six years of enterprise selling in the acquiring and checkout space. Consistently over quota, comfortable working with operations and e-commerce leads, and known for winning complex deals with long negotiation cycles.

Experience

Senior Account Executive, Lumen Pay GmbH, Berlin (2021 - present)
- Sell acquiring and checkout solutions to mid-market and enterprise merchants across the DACH region.
- Sourced around 60 percent of my own pipeline through outbound research, LinkedIn outreach and referrals from partners.
- Take a consultative approach: I map each merchant's payment flows and recommend the right mix of acquiring, local payment methods and fraud tools.
- Own the full sales cycle from first call to signed contract, and manage a portfolio of 25 key accounts.
- Negotiated multi-year pricing structures worth more than 4 million euros in total contract value.
- Prepare proposals and presentations for heads of e-commerce at mid-sized retailers.
- Wrote a Python script that pulls gateway data to spot merchants with falling authorisation rates; the account team uses it in every review.
- Gave the commercial lead quarterly feedback on competitor offers and customer needs.

Sales Development Manager, Brightmark Software, Hamburg (2019 - 2021)
- Led a team of six sales development reps focused on enterprise prospects.
- Built a partner network of acquirers and e-commerce platforms that now refers leads to us regularly.

Education
Bachelor of Arts in International Business, Hochschule Pforzheim, 2018

Skills
- Enterprise sales and full-cycle deal management
- Payments and fintech
- Negotiation and commercial structuring
- Excellent communication
- Languages: English (fluent), German (fluent)

Priya Nair
Berlin, Germany

Summary
B2B sales professional with three years of enterprise selling in software. Reliable forecaster, strong at building relationships with procurement teams.

Experience

Account Executive, Quellwerk Software GmbH, Berlin (2022 - present)
- Sell B2B subscription software to mid-market companies and enterprise procurement teams.
- Negotiate annual contracts with procurement and finance teams, usually over several rounds.
- Take deals from the first discovery call to signature and update my account plans every week.
- Advise customers on which of our modules fits their workflow, in a consultative style.
- Present proposals to CFOs and finance directors at prospect companies.
- Run outreach for my own pipeline, mainly through events and cold calling. Hit quota in one year out of three, and sourced about a third of my pipeline myself.
- Communicate clearly with customers and the implementation team, which has kept our renewal rate high.

Sales Representative, Nordic Office Supplies, Hamburg (2021 - 2022)
- Sold office equipment contracts to small and mid-sized companies.
- Visited customers and handled inbound enquiries.
- Built the monthly forecast spreadsheet that the sales director uses in the board deck.

Achievements
- Won the regional rookie of the year award in 2023.
- Helped launch the company's new onboarding guide for account executives.
- Joined the company's cross-team customer feedback group, which meets every month to review product issues.

Education
Bachelor of Science in Economics, University of Hamburg, 2020

Skills
- Enterprise B2B sales
- Salesforce CRM
- Forecasting
- Languages: English (fluent), French (school level)

Tom Lindqvist
Frankfurt, Germany

Summary
Pharmaceutical sales representative with four years of experience calling on hospitals and clinics. Trained in biology, strong on relationships and on presentations to clinicians. Now looking to switch into a new industry.

Experience

Sales Representative, Helvia Pharma GmbH, Frankfurt (2021 - present)
- Visit hospital departments and clinics to present our medical device range to clinicians and purchasing staff.
- Send monthly visit reports to my line manager and keep my territory notes up to date.
- Took part in regional training days, where I presented product updates to around 40 new representatives.
- Attend medical congresses and present clinical data at booth events.

Junior Sales Representative, Helvia Pharma GmbH, Frankfurt (2019 - 2021)
- Supported senior reps with hospital accounts and assisted with tender paperwork.
- Maintained the customer database in our CRM.
- Prepared visit schedules and route plans for the regional team each week.

Achievements
- Top performer for the Hessen region in 2023 for product presentations.
- Organised two regional training events with around 60 participants in total.
- Volunteer first aid instructor for a local first aid association, teaching community courses on weekends.

Courses
- Clinical trial basics (online course, 2020).
- Public speaking workshop (2021).
- Medical device safety refresher (2022).

Interests
I enjoy hiking with my dog and reading history books on weekends.

Education
Bachelor of Science in Biology, Goethe University Frankfurt, 2019

Skills
- Clinical product presentations
- Medical device knowledge
- Microsoft Office and Salesforce CRM
- Languages: German (native), English (fluent)

Marathon running, first aid volunteering and cooking for friends.
